cards.title: Idea shadow-tracker: mechanical outcomes for EVERY scan idea
cards.notes: Founder ask: ideas he doesn't take must still build the win% record. Every validated idea gets shadow-resolved by price action alone: pending → triggered (entry zone touched within TTL) → won/lost/expired (target vs stop, conservative same-bar rule). Separable later: raw scan win% vs founder-filter value-add vs conviction lane. This is 5b's outcome machinery built early. No trading/ involvement — pure journaling.
